<title level="1" right="Action">[Antler Catapult](/Actions.aspx?ID=2781) <actions string="Two Actions" /></title>

<traits>

</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 91

</column>

---

The elk Steps once and then makes an antlers Strike. If it moved and hits, the elk can fling its target into the space it just left, which is [forced movement](/Rules.aspx?ID=2364).
name: Antler Catapult
